This is the third public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC2

- Fixed a reboot failure caused by an old NPMplus container retaining the deleted one-time administrator-password mount from `/run`.
- Made fresh installations remove bootstrap credentials safely by recreating NPMplus from the sanitized Compose configuration before deleting the temporary secret.
- Added automatic repair for affected existing installations when running **Safe update**.
- Improved the integrated and standalone CrowdSec doctor so Docker startup failures are reported before secondary key checks.
- Hardened CrowdSec, Anubis, and Caddy with read-only root filesystems, dropped Linux capabilities, `no-new-privileges`, bounded temporary storage, and service health checks.
- Updated the custom Caddy build dependencies, disabled its administration endpoint and configuration persistence, and changed the runtime to an unprivileged user.
- Expanded CI to test installation, Docker restart, failed-update rollback, database integrity, uninstall, clean reinstall, and another restart.
- Added release gates for the exact recommended Caddy, CrowdSec, and Anubis images on AMD64 and ARM64, plus identity-backed attestations for release assets and container images.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.3/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.3/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. Safe update repairs the stale bootstrap-secret mount when present, takes a complete snapshot, validates the updated stack, and restores the previous working state if validation fails.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
